product.product: 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Aqua Gel SPF 50 & PA++++

evidence.text: Measured in 100 Willow users: 75% had a visible change in lines or dark spots held to week 8 (non-users with the same goals 28%). Mixed.
Measured in 24 Willow users with a dark spots goal: 67% had a visible change held to week 8 (non-users 15%). Mixed.
Measured in 18 Willow users with a lines goal: 50% had a visible change held to week 8 (non-users 24%). Mixed.
Among the Willow users with a visible change, half saw it begin by week 6. Mixed.
Measured in 16 Willow users with sensitive skin: 75% had a visible change held to week 8 (non-users with sensitive skin 19%). Mixed.
Measured in 100 Willow users: 81% were still using it at week 8. Mixed.

the-derma-co-1-hyaluronic-sunscreen-aqua.evidence_caveat: Observational real-world data, not a controlled trial. Do not present as clinical substantiation. Measured outcomes only; no self-reported results are included.
